text:
olivia_sec: Quick thread — prepping the 'SealChain' private deploy hardening pass. Key lines: network policies for the keystore, stricter RBAC for service accounts, audit fields for decrypt events, and a minimal-risk vuln patch plan. Any red flags?

harry_infra: +1. Important: the keystore agent needs OCSP and HSM CA reachability. Do not open 0.0.0.0/0; instead allow specific FQDNs/IPs and DNS to `kube-dns.kube-system.svc.cluster.local`.

jamie_ops: Audit notes: log `caller_sa`, `pod_uid`, `kms_req_id`, and `hsm_rc` on every decrypt attempt. We missed `pod_uid` previously which made forensics hard. Also tag events with `env:privedge` and `team:keystore`.

zara_devsec: RBAC plan: remove any broad `edit` bindings in the keystore namespace. Replace with a `keystore-access` Role granting only `create: secrets/keystore-requests` and `get` on pods. Example YAML coming.

olivia_sec: For the vuln in the sidecar base image (libssl), propose: build patch image, run 5000 simulated decrypts against HSM sim, canary to one AZ, measure error ratio. If >0.2% failures -> rollback.

harry_infra: Canary pod must mirror prod netpols and service mesh routes. We had a previous false positive when canary egress differed.

jamie_ops: Alerting formula to detect regressions: `rate(kms_decrypt_errors[5m]) / rate(kms_decrypt_requests[5m]) > 0.002`. If triggered -> open P1, failover to hosted fallback, and post to #privedge-ops.

zara_devsec: RBAC snippet (minimal):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: keystore-minimal
  namespace: keystore
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["create","get"]
```

harry_infra: Netpol example: `netpol-keystore-egress.yaml` will restrict egress to HSM IP list + metrics endpoint and kube-dns.

olivia_sec: Incident play: if decrypt failure ratio >0.5% for 10m, trigger bridge, switch traffic to hosted model, and archive affected audit logs for legal review.

bridge-bot: sealchain-canary started by harry_infra at 1730000050 — status: running.

jamie_ops: Action items: zara -> PR with RBAC; harry -> netpol + canary manifest; jamie -> SIEM mapping and alert rule; olivia -> coordinate canary window. Sync tomorrow 11:00 PT. :white_check_mark:
